title: 1948 y la abolición del ejército: Un pacto civil
goal: Examine the 1948 demilitarization of Costa Rica, constitutional pacifism, and resource reallocation to public education using historical-political discourse.
grammar: Discurso de desmilitarización y pacifismo constitucional

sections.title: Unit 7: Costa Rica — Lesson 2
body: Welcome to lesson 2 of Unit 7 in the Latin American Regional Studies track: Costa Rica: Demilitarization, Biodiversity & Democratic Welfare.
In this lesson, we explore 1948 y la abolición del ejército: un pacto civil, examining the country's environmental, civic, and economic models.

items: Examine the 1948 demilitarization of Costa Rica, constitutional pacifism, and resource reallocation to public education using historical-political discourse.
Master the terminology and syntax of abolicion-ejercito-pacto-civil.
Deploy advanced socio-environmental vocabulary (la proscripción, el pacto civil).
